```{r}
codes <- read_excel("C:/Users/nan/OneDrive - Universidad de Costa Rica/cuenta personal/ucr pers/practica profesional/practica dengue/dengue-model/data/raw/dengue_limpio.xlsx")

codes <- codes |> 
  select(ID, "PROVINCIA Y CANTON") |> 
  filter(ID >= 101)

colnames(codes) = c("ID", "site1")

codesprueba <- codes[which(101 <= codes["ID"]), 1:ncol(codes)]
```

```{r}
codes[11, "site1"] = "VAZQUEZ DE CORONADO"
codes[20, "site1"] = "LEON CORTES CASTRO"
codes[31, "site1"] = "ZARCERO"
codes[32, "site1"] = "SARCHI"
```


```{r}
baseNDVI_sites <- baseNDVI_sites |> 
  mutate(site2 = toupper(site)) |> 
  mutate(site1 = chartr("áéíóúñÁÉÍÓÚ", "aeiounAEIOU", site2))
```

```{r}
baseNDVI <- left_join(baseNDVI_sites, codes, by = "site1")

baseNDVI <- baseNDVI |> 
  mutate(fecha = ymd(calendar_date)) |> 
  select(c(value, fecha, ID)) 
```

```{r}
colnames(baseNDVI) <- c("ndvi", "fecha", "ID")
```


```{r}
write.csv(baseNDVI, "C:/Users/nan/OneDrive - Universidad de Costa Rica/cuenta personal/ucr pers/practica profesional/practica dengue/dengue-model/data/raw/baseNDVI.csv")
```
